items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...His sister... His sister lives around there. >> [INTERVIEWEE] His sister lives right there on there. That in Galveston.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know what he did after you left here. He's got some people live... Sister... One day... I'll contact one day. His sister... His sister lives around there.
His sister lives right there on there. That in Galveston.

Johnny St. Cyr gave me a picture of that... Johnny St. Cyr? I think he played there a little bit. Did he ever work with you? He what? Did Johnny ever play with you? What happened to him? Did he play or work in that same band? In the same band? With you? At the New Garden?
